timing.excluded: Output directory creation precedes the policy timer; process/model startup, source network/preparation, private evaluation and statistical aggregation are separate. These are policy execution times on this observed CPU host, not total service or interactive startup latency.
timing.included: Actual endpoint/audio/image decode, all selected model/flow/OCR operations, gate computation, output serialization/readback and digest. Video metadata write is included. Every speech arm writes its public metadata and reopens the actual delivered transcript; original-engine arms additionally reopen the metadata inside the timer, while the encoder-gate metadata is reopened by the later auditor. Document final public-result bookkeeping is outside the returned timer.
